lastCompletedStory.title: Tear down the lingering worker pane on every supervisor terminal exit

nextStoryContext: US-001 complete. Added teardownWorkerPaneFn injectable to RunSupervisorOptions (src/supervisor/loop.ts). All 16 terminal-exit sites in runSupervisor now call finishTerminal() which unconditionally invokes teardownWorkerPaneFn after notifyTerminal. Production wiring in host.ts uses spawnSync tmux kill-pane -t <pane-id> via readWorkerPaneMarker for up-to-date pane id. 6 new unit tests + 1 real-tmux integration test anchor the behavior. File-size budgets raised accordingly (wc-l+1 convention). Ordering invariant preserved: autoShipFn fires before teardownWorkerPaneFn on the complete path.

officialDocsValidated.version: system tmux (no JS SDK; spawnSync argv only)
officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed: kill-pane destroys the pane container (not just the process), reducing total pane count. Syntax tmux kill-pane -t <target-pane> matches production implementation in host.ts.
